data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Updated May 31, 2023

## [WOULD NOT RECOMMEND. No Bench, No Refund.](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6476ada4706f837cb1f4c126)
Ordered a bench that said it was in stock. Waited months, was told it was suddenly out of stock and would be a couple more months. Canceled the order and they emailed me that a refund was approved. It’s more than a month later and they still have more than $1000 of my money. Would NOT recommend. Update: interesting that after leaving a 1-star review I received another email saying a refund was on the way. We’ll see if I actually get it!

March 5, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 31, 2023

Hello, we’re so sorry to hear that your order was cancelled and fully refunded due to inventory issues with our supplier. Apologies for the inconvenience this has caused. We have shared this with our teams and are working to improve our order processes in the future.
